ambiguities_or_notes: Exact audited Russian Markdown source bytes were revalidated in this runtime against the pinned SHA-256.
All three printed page markers, the opening daily schedule, general rules, music rules, estate-management rules, Notes section, and all twelve apparatus notes are represented.
в 8-м часу is rendered toward 8, reflecting the historical Russian expression for the eighth hour rather than falsely specifying exactly 8:00.
Tolstoy's sexual rule about having no woman at his country place is preserved without euphemistic moralization; the source itself gives the exceptions in deliberately vague terms.
The musical terms cadenza and doigté remain visible language switches; the editorial gloss расстановка пальцев is translated as fingering.

Учить одну пьесу ... пока не будет места, где будешь останавливаться is preserved closely as do not go farther until there is a place where you will stop. The Russian is logically awkward and has not been silently emended to no place.
The Petersburg paragraph ends in an unfinished or grammatically suspended construction in the source; English preserves that suspension rather than supplying a missing consequence.
